fact: Jimjar bets the party five empty spell gems that meeting with the clan leaders is the right thing to do.
source_quote: I’ll bet you five empty spell gems that meeting with them is the right thing to do.
subject: Jimjar's bet offer

fact: Jimjar tells the party they will have to figure out how to get rid of the oozes.
source_quote: But you’re going to have to figure out how to get rid of the oozes.
subject: Jimjar's hint about oozes

fact: Glabbagool corrects the party, stating that it is not an ooze, but a cube.
source_quote: It’s not an ooze, it’s a cube.
subject: Glabbagool

fact: The deep gnomes of Blingdenstone are suffering from an extensive ooze infestation.
source_quote: Jimjar clarified that Blingdenstone was suffering from an extensive ooze infestation.
subject: Deep gnomes

fact: Jimjar states there are tons of oozes around.
subject: Deep gnomes

fact: Jimjar confirms that the party will receive the empty spell gems if they go talk to the clan leaders.
source_quote: You’ll get some spell gems, but you’ll have to go talk to them.
subject: Bet terms clarification

fact: The party accepts Jimjar's bet and proceeds with the meeting.
source_quote: The party accepts the bet and proceeds, interpreting Jimjar’s wager as support for meeting the clan leaders and a warning about the task awaiting them.
subject: Bet acceptance

fact: The party recognizes Jimjar's bet implies they will be sent on a quest to deal with the ooze infestation.
source_quote: Yeah, you’re betting we’re going to be sent on a quest, is what I’m hearing.
subject: Ooze infestation
